rules.statement: A compromise entered into on behalf of a minor must be approved by the court to be valid and effectual, as per section 500 of the Civil Procedure Code.
rules.supporting_quote: "In order to maintain the validity of a compromise under section 462 of the Indian Code of Civil Procedure, which corresponds to section 500 of our Code, entered into on behalf of a minor, when such compromise is subsequently challenged, it must be proved that the attention of the Court was directly called to the fact that a minor was a party to the compromise, and it ought to be shown by an order on petition, or in some way not open to doubt, that the leave of the Court was obtained."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: section 500 of the Civil Procedure Code
